bandReport.notes:
SEAMS. p08 (read, not transcribed) ends with Q60 complete, options (a)-(d) all printed, and no Directions block open across the p08/p09 seam - the band starts cleanly at Q61. p13 (read, not transcribed) OPENS a new Directions block of its own ('next three (03) items', the two pie-charts backing Q83-85), so nothing of mine runs past p12 and the band ends cleanly at Q82. No question straddles either seam.

SETS. Six Directions blocks, and every one of them STARTS inside this band, so no set is owned elsewhere and none is skipped: D61-70 (starts p09, the ten-item data-sufficiency block - Q61-67 on p09, Q68-70 on p10), D71-72 (p10), D73-75 (starts p10; Q73 on p10, Q74-75 on p11), D76-78 (p11), D79-80 (p12), D81-82 (p12). All members contiguous.

DATA-SUFFICIENCY FORMAT (Q61-70). This block prints its four lettered choices ONCE, inside the Directions text on p09, and no item 61-70 prints options of its own. The four choices are therefore repeated verbatim as each item's A-D options so every row carries a full option set, and context holds the Directions preamble up to 'Answer each item using the following instructions :'. The lead-in words 'Choose option' that introduce the list are deliberately not duplicated into context, since the list itself renders as the options. Each item's own preamble, Question, Statement-I and Statement-II are in its stem. Reversible if the pipeline would rather carry the choices in context instead.

FIGURES. Three printed figures in the band, each SHARED by a whole set, so hasFigure is set on all members of each: the square ABCD with triangle CEF (p11 left column, lower half - Q76/77/78), the circle with the smaller circle on OC and two hatched segments (p12 left column, upper half - Q79/80), and the two parallel perpendicular segments PQ and RS on line AB (p12 right column, upper half - Q81/82). Q71-72 mention a 'pie-diagram' but NO pie chart is printed - the sector ratio is given in words only, so hasFigure is not set. Q77 depends on the figure alone for the meaning of alpha and beta, and Q76/78 for which vertices E and F lie on, so all three crops are load-bearing rather than decorative. No printed data tables anywhere in the band.

ZOOM CHECKS at 5-8x against the source PDF: Q64 Statement-I (minus sign is INSIDE the cube-root radical, radicand 0.19683), Q65 Statement-II coefficients, and every numeric option of Q71, Q72, Q73, Q75, Q76, Q77, Q78, Q79, Q80, Q81, Q82 read off the page label by label.

DECIMALS. The booklet prints a raised middle dot; transcribed as a full stop per the brief (Q75 21.6/18.2/17.4/15.4, Q79 38.5/52.5/66.5).
